body:
More general script that also reproduces in Vim:
```vim
set nohidden
autocmd BufLeave * call tabpagebuflist()
tabnew
let b = bufnr()
vnew
autocmd BufUnload <buffer> ++once exe b .. 'bwipe!'
quit
```
and the crash also happens if `BufLeave` is changed to `WinLeave` or `TabLeave`.
Hmm, this seems similar to the problem fixed in vim/vim#14166. However, `TabLeave` should ideally still be triggered in the case, while `BufLeave` and `WinLeave` shouldn't.

issue.title: Crash in BufLeave after BufUnload closes other windows
issue.body:
Problem:  Crash in BufLeave/WinLeave/TabLeave when closing window after
          BufUnload closes all other windows in the tab page.
Solution: Avoid duplicate BufLeave/WinLeave events. Trigger TabLeave
          before removing the buffer.

related: #14166
related: neovim/neovim#33603
